name: What is the difference between semi-gloss and satin paint for bathrooms?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between semi-gloss and satin paint for bathrooms?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both semi-gloss and satin finishes are popular for bathrooms due to their durability and ease of cleaning. Satin paint has a soft, subtle sheen, offering a slightly more elegant look. Semi-gloss has a higher sheen, making it more reflective and even more resistant to moisture and easier to wipe down. The choice often comes down to the desired aesthetic and level of gloss.
acceptedAnswer.description: Satin paint has a subtle sheen, while semi-gloss has a higher, more reflective sheen, offering increased durability and moisture resistance for bathrooms.
